subject: world_language
concept: Combining passive voice, reported speech, register awareness, summarizing, and debate into an extended real-world task
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans an extended task combining several of this unit's skills
exercise.abstract: Student performs an extended spoken or written task in the target language combining at least three skills from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: task demonstrates at least three of this unit's skill areas working together coherently
misconception_flags: uses each skill in isolation without integrating them into one coherent piece of communication

interest_binding: task topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
